title: Uruguayan Pasta with Cacao Sauce
description: A unique dessert made by combining pasta with a rich and creamy cacao sauce, inspired by the flavors of Uruguay.
instructions: Cook spaghetti according to package instructions until al dente. Drain and set aside.
In a medium saucepan, melt butter over low heat. Add cacao powder and whisk until smooth.
Add granulated sugar and cook for 2-3 minutes, stirring constantly, until the mixture thickens.
Gradually add heavy cream, whisking continuously to avoid lumps.
Bring the mixture to a simmer and cook for 5-7 minutes, or until the sauce thickens to your liking.
Remove from heat and stir in vanilla extract. Season with salt to taste.
Combine cooked spaghetti and cacao sauce in a large serving dish. Toss to coat.
